items.name: Official OMP installer
items.help: Official binary installation. Files: install-omp.sh (Linux) or install-omp.bat (Windows). Args: [vVERSION], empty = latest stable. Example: ["v18.8.9"]. PI_INSTALL_DIR changes destination; default ~/.local/bin or %LOCALAPPDATA%/omp. Requires HTTPS/network; Linux may install missing OS utilities with sudo. Windows requires PowerShell 5.1. No Bun/Node/Go needed. See docs/INSTALLATION.md.
